title: Shein founder Xu Yangtian made a rare public appearance in Guangdong, pledging to invest ~$1.45B into the province's supply chains in the next three years (William Langley/Financial Times)
summary: William Langley / Financial Times: Shein founder Xu Yangtian made a rare public appearance in Guangdong, pledging to invest ~$1.45B into the province's supply chains in the next three years — Xu Yangtian says help from Communist Party and regional province was vital to fast-fashion retailer
